title: Photon flux versus energy
statement:
A monochromatic source is dimmed without changing its frequency. What is unchanged?

[_]{a}

choices: Photon arrival rate across the beam
Number of photons emitted in a fixed time
explanations: Dimming reduces the delivered optical power for the same beam setup.
At fixed photon energy lower power means fewer photons per second.

hints: The intensity change concerns the beam, not its individual photon energy.
solution: Compare before and after frequency. Each photon carries hν. The intensity change concerns the beam, not its individual photon energy. Frequency stayed fixed.
